sdk.errorMessage: SmartCon requires a .NET 10 SDK from the 10.0.1xx feature band (10.0.100 or a later 1xx patch). The 10.0.2xx band has confirmed WPF build regressions (dotnet/wpf#11678, dotnet/sdk#53508) and is not supported. Install the latest 10.0.1xx SDK from https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/10.0 — newer bands may remain installed side-by-side.
